_comment: Granola category config. Granola is a SUB-POOL of the shared breakfast cereals corpus — the split is expressed via subpool_filter on bsip_cereal_subtype=granola. Corpus: run_cereals_005 (66 products, Shufersal) + run_cereals_multiretailer_001 (37 products, Carrefour/Yochananof), ordered by priority. Run: run_cereals_008 (63 shufersal traces) + run_cereals_multiretailer_001 (37 multi-retailer traces). Only traces whose BSIP1 record has bsip_cereal_subtype=granola are displayed. The _meta.subpool_filter documents this split so G3 can enumerate it. Discovered via: granola.ts imports granola-page-data.ts which imports granola_frontend_v1.json; provenance: 'run_cereals_005 granola sub-pool + run_cereals_multiretailer_001 EV-045'.
